content: {"overall": "The report is consistent with its tables and labels deviations clearly; two presentation issues.", "issues": [{"severity": "medium", "location": "S1", "issue": "The interaction p-value is close to 0.02 with 290 respondents in the two-party subsample; the prose should state the subsample size.", "fix": "Add N for the S1 subsample to the narrative.", "kind": "presentational", "change": null}, {"severity": "high", "location": "H2", "kind": "analytical", "change": {"target": "H2", "type": "covariates"}, "issue": "The policy-support model adjusts for party and age but not education, which predicts both the outcome and attention; the estimate may be sensitive to it.", "fix": "Re-estimate H2 adding educ as a covariate and report whether the conclusion changes."}]}
